view_claims.claim: Pydantic v2 BaseModel.model_copy(update=...) does not validate the supplied update values before creating the copied model.

SQLite permits only one simultaneous write transaction, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another connection already has an active write transaction.
RFC 3161 describes time-stamping evidence that a datum existed before a particular time.
Local seal, plan, registration and first-view timestamps alone cannot prove that a clip was generated after its intent was sealed.
Pydantic v2 BaseModel.model_copy(update=...) does not validate supplied update values.
SQLite permits only one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another connection has an active write transaction.
RFC 3161 describes timestamping evidence that a datum existed before a particular time.
Local seal, plan, registration and first-view timestamps alone cannot prove generation occurred after sealing; witnessing intent existence does not itself witness clip generation.
